articles.title: Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India must shore up its partnerships in the Asian region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Each year, the summits of the 11-member Association of South-East Asian Nations mark an important moment on the diplomatic calendar: India is able to interact with all of its partners in the Indo-Pacific and engage global powers at the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s talks with Indo-Pacific players focused on a future shaped “not by competition, but by cooperation”. This year, the summit in Manila hosted by the Philippines had many other imperatives. These were the first ASEAN summits since the U.S.-Israel attacks on Iran and Iran’s Hormuz blockade and strikes on Gulf countries that have upended energy and trade across South and South East Asia. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call for “peace, stability, and predictability” in the world during the EAS was aimed as much at leaders from the U.S., Russia and China as it was for the region. The visit had a bilateral context — the Philippines and India have intensified ties considerably in the past year, since the visit of President Bongbong Marcos to Delhi in August 2025, including the upgradation of the Strategic Partnership, maritime exchanges and negotiations over the supply of more Indian-made Brahmos missile battery systems to the Philippines. This year, after months of concerns about U.S. President Donald Trump’s lack of interest in the Quad grouping, the U.S. decided to host a summit of U.S.-India-Australia-Japan Quad leaders on the side-lines of the ASEAN summits, the first time the summit has been held in a non-Quad country.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Given the stakes, there were several outcomes from all the three summits that PM Modi attended back-to-back on Tuesday — the ASEAN India Summit launched a new cooperation on disaster management, and the East Asia Summit focused on countering cyber-crime. PM Modi’s announcement that India would give all ASEAN citizens free tourist visas is expected to increase people-to-people interactions and trade. At the Quad summit, President Trump made a number of announcements including the launch of a Quad Business leaders forum, to be held in Mumbai next year, and the first Quad naval exercises with patrol aircraft. However, the outcomes in Manila paled in significance to the anticipation over Mr. Trump’s next stop in Shenzhen for the Asia Pacific Economic Conference (APEC), with an unprecedented three-way summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping planned on Thursday. New Delhi must watch the outcomes of that summit among the “global superpowers” much more closely.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #1 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:15:48 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India must shore up its partnerships in the Asian region

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Each year, the summits of the 11-member Association of South-East Asian Nations mark an important moment on the diplomatic calendar: India is able to interact with all of its partners in the Indo-Pacific and engage global powers at the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s talks with Indo-Pacific players focused on a future shaped “not by competition, but by cooperation”. This year, the summit in Manila hosted by the Philippines had many other imperatives. These were the first ASEAN summits since the U.S.-Israel attacks on Iran and Iran’s Hormuz blockade and strikes on Gulf countries that have upended energy and trade across South and South East Asia. Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call for “peace, stability, and predictability” in the world during the EAS was aimed as much at leaders from the U.S., Russia and China as it was for the region. The visit had a bilateral context — the Philippines and India have intensified ties considerably in the past year, since the visit of President Bongbong Marcos to Delhi in August 2025, including the upgradation of the Strategic Partnership, maritime exchanges and negotiations over the supply of more Indian-made Brahmos missile battery systems to the Philippines. This year, after months of concerns about U.S. President Donald Trump’s lack of interest in the Quad grouping, the U.S. decided to host a summit of U.S.-India-Australia-Japan Quad leaders on the side-lines of the ASEAN summits, the first time the summit has been held in a non-Quad country.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Given the stakes, there were several outcomes from all the three summits that PM Modi attended back-to-back on Tuesday — the ASEAN India Summit launched a new cooperation on disaster management, and the East Asia Summit focused on countering cyber-crime. PM Modi’s announcement that India would give all ASEAN citizens free tourist visas is expected to increase people-to-people interactions and trade. At the Quad summit, President Trump made a number of announcements including the launch of a Quad Business leaders forum, to be held in Mumbai next year, and the first Quad naval exercises with patrol aircraft. However, the outcomes in Manila paled in significance to the anticipation over Mr. Trump’s next stop in Shenzhen for the Asia Pacific Economic Conference (APEC), with an unprecedented three-way summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping planned on Thursday. New Delhi must watch the outcomes of that summit among the “global superpowers” much more closely.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Announcement (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Announcement' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Significance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Significance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. India must shore up its partnerships in the Asian region.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India must shore up its partnerships in the Asian region." (Hinglish Arth: भारत को एशियाई क्षेत्र में अपनी भागीदारी को बढ़ाना होगा)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Many imperatives: On India’s Asia diplomacy"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. New Delhi must watch the outcomes of that summit among the “global superpowers” much more closely.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "New Delhi must watch the outcomes of that summit among the “global superpowers” much more closely." (Hinglish Arth: नई दिल्ली को "वैश्विक महाशक्तियों" के बीच उस शिखर सम्मेलन के नतीजों पर अधिक बारीकी से नजर रखनी चाहिए।)

articles.title: Testing times: On India’s two-Test series against New Zealand

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India needs to be at its best in Tests against New Zealand

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: New Zealand at home remains an indomitable cricketing opposition. Even the great West Indian squad led by Clive Lloyd suffered a 0-1 Test series defeat in 1980. Pitches that look lush as English meadows, the wind that is often bone-chilling cold, and fast bowlers relishing their prospects, make any tour of New Zealand a difficult outing. So far, the visiting Indians have done well, having won the T20I and ODI series, but the real contest starts with the first Test at Wellington’s Basin Reserve from Thursday. The Shubman Gill-led men’s last overseas tour of Sri Lanka ended with a middling 1-0 victory in the two Tests, but more needs to be done against New Zealand in the latest two-Test series. Placed fourth in the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) table, and with hopes of securing a final berth seemingly fragile, India is in a win-all-games situation first up against New Zealand and later when Australia arrives next year. Against current WTC topper New Zealand, the Indian batters have to stay anchored. This is a line-up that no longer has Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane. Gill and company get another opportunity to reiterate their credentials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For some rugged inspiration they need not look beyond coach Gautam Gambhir in their dressing room. The doughty former India opener batted for 643 minutes while scoring a match-saving 137 in the Napier Test during the 2009 tour. The southpaw will be hoping that the current batting unit, which is high on flair, will remain sober and effectively counter the host. K.L. Rahul, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal and Gill have the onerous task of negating the New Zealand seamers in their backyard. Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel add depth, and if the former can successfully unleash his maverick batting approach, India can upset the host’s best-laid plans. New Zealand will miss the retired Kane Williamson but its batters would be comfortable on familiar surfaces. For India, much would hinge on how Jasprit Bumrah bowls. If the spearhead clicks, then it becomes easier for much of his support-cast that includes the persevering Mohammed Siraj, who was a touch rusty in Sri Lanka. From the squads of the past to the present unit, Ravindra Jadeja remains the link. Whether he will get a role to play or whether the management prefers an all-pace attack, remains a matter of conjecture. The home team led by Tom Latham will depend on Matt Henry, Kyle Jameson and other pacers, to choke the Indian batters. A hard task awaits India, first at Wellington and then at Christchurch.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Testing times: On India’s two-Test series against New Zealand

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 01:11:39 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India needs to be at its best in Tests against New Zealand

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: New Zealand at home remains an indomitable cricketing opposition. Even the great West Indian squad led by Clive Lloyd suffered a 0-1 Test series defeat in 1980. Pitches that look lush as English meadows, the wind that is often bone-chilling cold, and fast bowlers relishing their prospects, make any tour of New Zealand a difficult outing. So far, the visiting Indians have done well, having won the T20I and ODI series, but the real contest starts with the first Test at Wellington’s Basin Reserve from Thursday. The Shubman Gill-led men’s last overseas tour of Sri Lanka ended with a middling 1-0 victory in the two Tests, but more needs to be done against New Zealand in the latest two-Test series. Placed fourth in the ICC World Test Championship (WTC) table, and with hopes of securing a final berth seemingly fragile, India is in a win-all-games situation first up against New Zealand and later when Australia arrives next year. Against current WTC topper New Zealand, the Indian batters have to stay anchored. This is a line-up that no longer has Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane. Gill and company get another opportunity to reiterate their credentials.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For some rugged inspiration they need not look beyond coach Gautam Gambhir in their dressing room. The doughty former India opener batted for 643 minutes while scoring a match-saving 137 in the Napier Test during the 2009 tour. The southpaw will be hoping that the current batting unit, which is high on flair, will remain sober and effectively counter the host. K.L. Rahul, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Devdutt Padikkal and Gill have the onerous task of negating the New Zealand seamers in their backyard. Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel add depth, and if the former can successfully unleash his maverick batting approach, India can upset the host’s best-laid plans. New Zealand will miss the retired Kane Williamson but its batters would be comfortable on familiar surfaces. For India, much would hinge on how Jasprit Bumrah bowls. If the spearhead clicks, then it becomes easier for much of his support-cast that includes the persevering Mohammed Siraj, who was a touch rusty in Sri Lanka. From the squads of the past to the present unit, Ravindra Jadeja remains the link. Whether he will get a role to play or whether the management prefers an all-pace attack, remains a matter of conjecture. The home team led by Tom Latham will depend on Matt Henry, Kyle Jameson and other pacers, to choke the Indian batters. A hard task awaits India, first at Wellington and then at Christchurch.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Opportunity (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Opportunity' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inspiration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inspiration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Opposition (Noun)
विरोध — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opposition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Management (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Management' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Testing times: On India’s two-Test series against New Zealand", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. India needs to be at its best in Tests against New Zealand.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Testing times: On India’s two-Test series agains' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Testing times: On India’s two-Test series aga' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Testing times: On India’s two-Test series aga' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India needs to be at its best in Tests against New Zealand." (Hinglish Arth: भारत को न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ टेस्ट में अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन करना होगा)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Testing times: On India’s two-Test series against New Zealand"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. A hard task awaits India, first at Wellington and then at Christchurch.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "A hard task awaits India, first at Wellington and then at Christchurch." (Hinglish Arth: पहले वेलिंगटन और फिर क्राइस्टचर्च में एक कठिन चुनौती भारत का इंतजार कर रही है।)

articles.title: Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Three months of lull established by security forces in Jammu and Kashmir was rattled by the back-to-back incidents of violence in the past six days. On November 11, a terror attack on a checkpoint manned by the personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in Kulgam left three jawans injured. On November 16, a local, whom the police suspected of having joined the terror ranks a few days ago, was killed after six days of a siege-like anti-terror operation in residential areas of Kulgam. In Jammu’s Kishtwar, two Special Police Officers (SPOs) of the J&K Police were found dead with bullet wounds, a day after they were reported missing in a forest range on November 11. The police and the Army, however, remain tight-lipped about the circumstances around the killing of these SPOs, and there are conflicting reports on the circumstances that led to their deaths. The anti-terror operation in civilian areas of Kulgam has raised concerns. Former J&K Chief Minister and PDP president Mehbooba Mufti described the operation, spread over six days, as “collective punishment that only breeds alienation and resentment,” while NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar suggested that entire villages were put under prolonged restrictions for days. The Omar Abdullah government , because of limited powers and no jurisdiction over the police in J&K, a Union Territory since 2019, finds itself hamstrung. The iron hand policy to stamp out terrorism and separatism has been effective from a strictly security perspective — terror attacks as well as local recruitments into terror ranks have declined. According to the police, local recruits have come down to single digit or fewer than 10 in Kashmir.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, the decline in terrorist incidents and the silence of the streets should not be mistaken for peace. The current situation demands a political reach-out by the Centre to all the stakeholders of J&K. It has to begin with the much-promised restoration of Statehood , which will give the voters a sense that their mass participation in the 2024 Assembly elections allowed their elected leaders to hold institutions accountable, and they were able to work freely to protect the interests of the region. Though the security agencies need to be focused on Pakistan-backed terrorism, it should not come at the cost of re-inflicting psychological scars within Kashmir, which could turn into a powder keg if left unattended. Healing through both political and security processes has to be complementary rather than conflicting. Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory." (Hinglish Arth: जम्मू-कश्मीर के राजनीतिक वर्ग को अपना अधिकार स्थापित करने की अनुमति देना और सुरक्षा एजेंसियों को चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए जगह प्रदान करना विरोधाभासी नहीं है।)

hinglishTracks.en: Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जम्मू-कश्मीर में शांति के लिए राज्य का दर्जा बहाल करना जरूरी है।

hinglishTracks.en: Three months of lull established by security forces in Jammu and Kashmir was rattled by the back-to-back incidents of violence in the past six days.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जम्मू-कश्मीर में सुरक्षा बलों द्वारा स्थापित तीन महीने की शांति पिछले छह दिनों में हिंसा की एक के बाद एक घटनाओं से परेशान हो गई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 11, a terror attack on a checkpoint manned by the personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in Kulgam left three jawans injured.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 11 नवंबर को, कुलगाम में केंद्रीय रिजर्व पुलिस बल (सीआरपीएफ) के जवानों द्वारा संचालित एक चौकी पर एक आतंकवादी हमले में तीन जवान घायल हो गए।।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 16, a local, whom the police suspected of having joined the terror ranks a few days ago, was killed after six days of a siege-like anti-terror operation in residential areas of Kulgam.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 16 नवंबर को, एक स्थानीय व्यक्ति, जिस पर पुलिस को कुछ दिन पहले आतंकवादी रैंकों में शामिल होने का संदेह था, कुलगाम के आवासीय इलाकों में छह दिनों की घेराबंदी जैसे आतंकवाद विरोधी अभियान के बाद मारा गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In Jammu’s Kishtwar, two Special Police Officers (SPOs) of the J&K Police were found dead with bullet wounds, a day after they were reported missing in a forest range on November 11.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जम्मू के किश्तवाड़ में, जम्मू-कश्मीर पुलिस के दो विशेष पुलिस अधिकारी (एसपीओ) 11 नवंबर को एक वन रेंज में लापता होने की सूचना मिलने के एक दिन बाद गोली लगने से घायल पाए गए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: The police and the Army, however, remain tight-lipped about the circumstances around the killing of these SPOs, and there are conflicting reports on the circumstances that led to their deaths.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि, पुलिस और सेना इन एसपीओ की हत्या की परिस्थितियों के बारे में चुप्पी साधे हुए हैं, और उन परिस्थितियों पर परस्पर विरोधी रिपोर्टें हैं जिनके कारण उनकी मृत्यु हुई।।

hinglishTracks.en: The anti-terror operation in civilian areas of Kulgam has raised concerns.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कुलगाम के नागरिक इलाकों में आतंक विरोधी अभियान ने चिंता बढ़ा दी है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Former J&K Chief Minister and PDP president Mehbooba Mufti described the operation, spread over six days, as “collective punishment that only breeds alienation and resentment,” while NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar suggested that entire villages were put under prolonged restrictions for days.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जम्मू-कश्मीर की पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री और पीडीपी अध्यक्ष महबूबा मुफ्ती ने छह दिनों तक चले इस ऑपरेशन को "सामूहिक सजा जो केवल अलगाव और नाराजगी पैदा करती है" के रूप में वर्णित किया, जबकि एनसी प्रवक्ता इमरान नबी डार ने सुझाव दिया कि पूरे गांवों को कई दिनों तक लंबे समय तक प्रतिबंधों के तहत रखा गया था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Omar Abdullah government , because of limited powers and no jurisdiction over the police in J&K, a Union Territory since 2019, finds itself hamstrung.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2019 से केंद्र शासित प्रदेश जम्मू-कश्मीर में सीमित शक्तियों और पुलिस पर कोई अधिकार क्षेत्र नहीं होने के कारण उमर अब्दुल्ला सरकार खुद को मुश्किल में महसूस कर रही है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Jurisdiction' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अधिकार क्षेत्र — न्यायालय या किसी संस्था की वह कानूनी सीमा जहाँ तक वह आदेश दे सके। इसके Synonyms हैं: Authority, Sovereignty, Cognizance और Antonyms हैं: Powerlessness, Subordination, Incompetence।

hinglishTracks.en: The iron hand policy to stamp out terrorism and separatism has been effective from a strictly security perspective — terror attacks as well as local recruitments into terror ranks have declined.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — आतंकवाद और अलगाववाद पर लगाम कसने की सख्त नीति सख्त सुरक्षा दृष्टिकोण से प्रभावी रही है - आतंकवादी हमलों के साथ-साथ आतंकवादी रैंकों में स्थानीय भर्तियों में भी गिरावट आई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: According to the police, local recruits have come down to single digit or fewer than 10 in Kashmir.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पुलिस के मुताबिक, कश्मीर में स्थानीय भर्तियां घटकर सिंगल डिजिट या 10 से भी कम रह गई हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: That said, the decline in terrorist incidents and the silence of the streets should not be mistaken for peace.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने कहा, आतंकवादी घटनाओं में कमी और सड़कों पर सन्नाटा को शांति समझने की भूल नहीं की जानी चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: The current situation demands a political reach-out by the Centre to all the stakeholders of J&K.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — वर्तमान स्थिति केंद्र द्वारा जम्मू-कश्मीर के सभी हितधारकों तक राजनीतिक पहुंच की मांग करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It has to begin with the much-promised restoration of Statehood , which will give the voters a sense that their mass participation in the 2024 Assembly elections allowed their elected leaders to hold institutions accountable, and they were able to work freely to protect the interests of the region.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसकी शुरुआत बहुप्रतीक्षित राज्य के दर्जे की बहाली से होनी चाहिए, जिससे मतदाताओं को यह एहसास होगा कि 2024 के विधानसभा चुनावों में उनकी सामूहिक भागीदारी ने उनके निर्वाचित नेताओं को संस्थानों को जवाबदेह रखने की अनुमति दी, और वे क्षेत्र के हितों की रक्षा के लिए स्वतंत्र रूप से काम करने में सक्षम थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Though the security agencies need to be focused on Pakistan-backed terrorism, it should not come at the cost of re-inflicting psychological scars within Kashmir, which could turn into a powder keg if left unattended.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालाँकि सुरक्षा एजेंसियों को पाकिस्तान समर्थित आतंकवाद पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने की आवश्यकता है, लेकिन इसे कश्मीर के भीतर मनोवैज्ञानिक घावों को फिर से पैदा करने की कीमत पर नहीं आना चाहिए, जो ध्यान न देने पर बारूद के ढेर में बदल सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Healing through both political and security processes has to be complementary rather than conflicting.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — राजनीतिक और सुरक्षा दोनों प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से उपचार परस्पर विरोधी होने के बजाय पूरक होना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जम्मू-कश्मीर के राजनीतिक वर्ग को अपना अधिकार स्थापित करने की अनुमति देना और सुरक्षा एजेंसियों को चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए जगह प्रदान करना विरोधाभासी नहीं है।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #3 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 10:22:36 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Three months of lull established by security forces in Jammu and Kashmir was rattled by the back-to-back incidents of violence in the past six days. On November 11, a terror attack on a checkpoint manned by the personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in Kulgam left three jawans injured. On November 16, a local, whom the police suspected of having joined the terror ranks a few days ago, was killed after six days of a siege-like anti-terror operation in residential areas of Kulgam. In Jammu’s Kishtwar, two Special Police Officers (SPOs) of the J&K Police were found dead with bullet wounds, a day after they were reported missing in a forest range on November 11. The police and the Army, however, remain tight-lipped about the circumstances around the killing of these SPOs, and there are conflicting reports on the circumstances that led to their deaths. The anti-terror operation in civilian areas of Kulgam has raised concerns. Former J&K Chief Minister and PDP president Mehbooba Mufti described the operation, spread over six days, as “collective punishment that only breeds alienation and resentment,” while NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar suggested that entire villages were put under prolonged restrictions for days. The Omar Abdullah government , because of limited powers and no jurisdiction over the police in J&K, a Union Territory since 2019, finds itself hamstrung. The iron hand policy to stamp out terrorism and separatism has been effective from a strictly security perspective — terror attacks as well as local recruitments into terror ranks have declined. According to the police, local recruits have come down to single digit or fewer than 10 in Kashmir.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, the decline in terrorist incidents and the silence of the streets should not be mistaken for peace. The current situation demands a political reach-out by the Centre to all the stakeholders of J&K. It has to begin with the much-promised restoration of Statehood , which will give the voters a sense that their mass participation in the 2024 Assembly elections allowed their elected leaders to hold institutions accountable, and they were able to work freely to protect the interests of the region. Though the security agencies need to be focused on Pakistan-backed terrorism, it should not come at the cost of re-inflicting psychological scars within Kashmir, which could turn into a powder keg if left unattended. Healing through both political and security processes has to be complementary rather than conflicting. Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Jurisdiction (Noun)
अधिकार क्षेत्र — न्यायालय या किसी संस्था की वह कानूनी सीमा जहाँ तक वह आदेश दे सके।
✓ Syn: Authority, Sovereignty, Cognizance  |  ✖ Ant: Powerlessness, Subordination, Incompetence
Participation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Participation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir." (Hinglish Arth: जम्मू-कश्मीर में शांति के लिए राज्य का दर्जा बहाल करना जरूरी है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Elusive peace: On Kashmir terror attack"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory." (Hinglish Arth: जम्मू-कश्मीर के राजनीतिक वर्ग को अपना अधिकार स्थापित करने की अनुमति देना और सुरक्षा एजेंसियों को चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए जगह प्रदान करना विरोधाभासी नहीं है।)

• 1. Core Context & Background: Restoration of Statehood is essential for peace in Jammu and Kashmir
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Three months of lull established by security forces in Jammu and Kashmir was rattled by the back-to-back incidents of violence in the past six days. On November 11, a terror attack on a checkpoint manned by the personnel of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) in Kulgam left three jawans injured. On November 16, a local, whom the police suspected of having joined the terror ranks a few days ago, was killed after six days of a siege-like anti-terror operation in residential areas of Kulgam. In Jammu’s Kishtwar, two Special Police Officers (SPOs) of the J&K Police were found dead with bullet wounds, a day after they were reported missing in a forest range on November 11. The police and the Army, however, remain tight-lipped about the circumstances around the killing of these SPOs, and there are conflicting reports on the circumstances that led to their deaths. The anti-terror operation in civilian areas of Kulgam has raised concerns. Former J&K Chief Minister and PDP president Mehbooba Mufti described the operation, spread over six days, as “collective punishment that only breeds alienation and resentment,” while NC spokesman Imran Nabi Dar suggested that entire villages were put under prolonged restrictions for days. The Omar Abdullah government , because of limited powers and no jurisdiction over the police in J&K, a Union Territory since 2019, finds itself hamstrung. The iron hand policy to stamp out terrorism and separatism has been effective from a strictly security perspective — terror attacks as well as local recruitments into terror ranks have declined. According to the police, local recruits have come down to single digit or fewer than 10 in Kashmir.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, the decline in terrorist incidents and the silence of the streets should not be mistaken for peace. The current situation demands a political reach-out by the Centre to all the stakeholders of J&K. It has to begin with the much-promised restoration of Statehood , which will give the voters a sense that their mass participation in the 2024 Assembly elections allowed their elected leaders to hold institutions accountable, and they were able to work freely to protect the interests of the region. Though the security agencies need to be focused on Pakistan-backed terrorism, it should not come at the cost of re-inflicting psychological scars within Kashmir, which could turn into a powder keg if left unattended. Healing through both political and security processes has to be complementary rather than conflicting. Allowing the political class of J&K to establish its writ and providing room to security agencies to combat challenges are not contradictory.

articles.title: All-too fallible: On India’s vote against moratorium on death penalty
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Death penalty requires a near-infallible criminal justice system

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s vote against a proposed global moratorium on the death penalty at the UN is consistent with its position at the forum; it has defended its retention of the penalty as a sovereign decision backed by judicial safeguards, including the “rarest of rare” condition and sessions courts’ sentences requiring a High Court’s confirmation. At the same time, the Supreme Court has increasingly restricted capital punishment and research has failed to find evidence of additional deterrence over life imprisonment . India’s distinction between judicial executions and extrajudicial killings is legally valid but its further claim that due process protects people facing execution is less so. While India last executed convicts in 2020, for the Delhi gang-rape and murder, Parliament expanded the number of capital offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita — a form of penal populism that projects the political attractiveness of the state’s response to public outrage, especially in cases of sexual violence, without addressing the poor policing and low conviction rates that actually undermine deterrence . The country had 574 people on death row on December 31, 2025, the highest since 2016, thanks to trial court rulings, challenging claims about judicial safeguards in practice. The report of the 2015 Law Commission headed by Justice A.P. Shah said the death penalty “fails to achieve any constitutionally valid penological goals” and recommended abolishing it for all crimes except terrorism and waging war. Only a small group of countries worldwide are executing more people. In India, per Project 39A, the Supreme Court released 38 persons from death row in 2016-2025 after they had spent eight years there on average. Some have endured more than two decades. The punishment requires a measure of infallibility that the criminal justice system cannot supply. The safeguards neither deter convictions in cases with flawed evidence, false testimony, and so on nor remedy unequal access to competent legal representation among those facing the penalty. India should formally suspend executions and commission a review of penalty statutes and the treatment of prisoners on death row. Second, it should spare offences that do not involve intentional killing from the penalty. Research suggests meting out excessively harsh punishments for non-fatal crimes could incentivise offenders to escalate their violence, including to kill potential witnesses. The greater goal should be to abolish the practice in law while improving investigative and prosecutorial practices and access to legal aid.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: prison / judiciary (system of justice) / crime, law and justice / United Nations / death penalty policies

hinglishTracks.en: Death penalty requires a near-infallible criminal justice system
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मृत्युदंड के लिए एक लगभग अचूक आपराधिक न्याय प्रणाली की आवश्यकता होती है। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Infallibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Infallibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s vote against a proposed global moratorium on the death penalty at the UN is consistent with its position at the forum; it has defended its retention of the penalty as a sovereign decision backed by judicial safeguards, including the “rarest of rare” condition and sessions courts’ sentences requiring a High Court’s confirmation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — संयुक्त राष्ट्र में मृत्युदंड पर प्रस्तावित वैश्विक रोक के खिलाफ भारत का वोट मंच पर उसकी स्थिति के अनुरूप है; इसने न्यायिक सुरक्षा उपायों द्वारा समर्थित एक संप्रभु निर्णय के रूप में दंड को बरकरार रखने का बचाव किया है, जिसमें "दुर्लभ से दुर्लभतम" स्थिति और सत्र अदालतों की सजाओं को उच्च न्यायालय की पुष्टि की आवश्यकता शामिल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: At the same time, the Supreme Court has increasingly restricted capital punishment and research has failed to find evidence of additional deterrence over life imprisonment .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — साथ ही, उच्चतम न्यायालय ने मृत्युदंड को तेजी से प्रतिबंधित कर दिया है और अनुसंधान आजीवन कारावास पर अतिरिक्त प्रतिबंध के सबूत खोजने में विफल रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s distinction between judicial executions and extrajudicial killings is legally valid but its further claim that due process protects people facing execution is less so.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — न्यायिक फांसी और गैर-न्यायिक हत्याओं के बीच भारत का अंतर कानूनी रूप से वैध है, लेकिन इसका आगे का दावा है कि उचित प्रक्रिया फांसी का सामना करने वाले लोगों की रक्षा करती है, ऐसा कम है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Extrajudicial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Extrajudicial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: While India last executed convicts in 2020, for the Delhi gang-rape and murder, Parliament expanded the number of capital offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita — a form of penal populism that projects the political attractiveness of the state’s response to public outrage, especially in cases of sexual violence, without addressing the poor policing and low conviction rates that actually undermine deterrence .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जबकि भारत ने आखिरी बार 2020 में दिल्ली सामूहिक बलात्कार और हत्या के दोषियों को फांसी दी थी, संसद ने भारतीय न्याय संहिता के तहत मृत्युदंड वाले अपराधों की संख्या का विस्तार किया - दंडात्मक लोकलुभावनवाद का एक रूप जो सार्वजनिक आक्रोश के प्रति राज्य की प्रतिक्रिया के राजनीतिक आकर्षण को दर्शाता है, विशेष रूप से यौन हिंसा के मामलों में, खराब पुलिसिंग और कम सजा दर को संबोधित किए बिना जो वास्तव में प्रतिरोध को कमजोर करता है।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — न्यायमूर्ति ए.पी. की अध्यक्षता में 2015 विधि आयोग की रिपोर्ट।

hinglishTracks.en: Shah said the death penalty “fails to achieve any constitutionally valid penological goals” and recommended abolishing it for all crimes except terrorism and waging war.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — शाह ने कहा कि मृत्युदंड "किसी भी संवैधानिक रूप से वैध दंडात्मक लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने में विफल है" और आतंकवाद और युद्ध छेड़ने को छोड़कर सभी अपराधों के लिए इसे समाप्त करने की सिफारिश की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Constitutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप। इसके Synonyms हैं: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful और Antonyms हैं: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — दुनिया भर में देशों का केवल एक छोटा समूह ही अधिक लोगों को फाँसी दे रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कुछ ने दो दशकों से अधिक समय तक सहन किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The punishment requires a measure of infallibility that the criminal justice system cannot supply.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सज़ा के लिए अचूकता की आवश्यकता होती है जिसे आपराधिक न्याय प्रणाली प्रदान नहीं कर सकती।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Infallibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Infallibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: The safeguards neither deter convictions in cases with flawed evidence, false testimony, and so on nor remedy unequal access to competent legal representation among those facing the penalty.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #4 of 30 (18 NOV)

📰 All-too fallible: On India’s vote against moratorium on death penalty

📌 Published: 18 Nov 2026, 08:25:25 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Death penalty requires a near-infallible criminal justice system

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s vote against a proposed global moratorium on the death penalty at the UN is consistent with its position at the forum; it has defended its retention of the penalty as a sovereign decision backed by judicial safeguards, including the “rarest of rare” condition and sessions courts’ sentences requiring a High Court’s confirmation. At the same time, the Supreme Court has increasingly restricted capital punishment and research has failed to find evidence of additional deterrence over life imprisonment . India’s distinction between judicial executions and extrajudicial killings is legally valid but its further claim that due process protects people facing execution is less so. While India last executed convicts in 2020, for the Delhi gang-rape and murder, Parliament expanded the number of capital offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita — a form of penal populism that projects the political attractiveness of the state’s response to public outrage, especially in cases of sexual violence, without addressing the poor policing and low conviction rates that actually undermine deterrence . The country had 574 people on death row on December 31, 2025, the highest since 2016, thanks to trial court rulings, challenging claims about judicial safeguards in practice. The report of the 2015 Law Commission headed by Justice A.P. Shah said the death penalty “fails to achieve any constitutionally valid penological goals” and recommended abolishing it for all crimes except terrorism and waging war. Only a small group of countries worldwide are executing more people. In India, per Project 39A, the Supreme Court released 38 persons from death row in 2016-2025 after they had spent eight years there on average. Some have endured more than two decades. The punishment requires a measure of infallibility that the criminal justice system cannot supply. The safeguards neither deter convictions in cases with flawed evidence, false testimony, and so on nor remedy unequal access to competent legal representation among those facing the penalty. India should formally suspend executions and commission a review of penalty statutes and the treatment of prisoners on death row. Second, it should spare offences that do not involve intentional killing from the penalty. Research suggests meting out excessively harsh punishments for non-fatal crimes could incentivise offenders to escalate their violence, including to kill potential witnesses. The greater goal should be to abolish the practice in law while improving investigative and prosecutorial practices and access to legal aid.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: prison / judiciary (system of justice) / crime, law and justice / United Nations / death penalty policies

संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Representation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Extrajudicial (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Extrajudicial' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Infallibility (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Infallibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world. The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident. Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world. The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks. If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else. But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure. That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible. Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded. But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy. There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes. There is no such thing as a reliable vendor. Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one. It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents. Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:11:33 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world. The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident. Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world. The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks. If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else. But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure. That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible. Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded. But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy. There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes. There is no such thing as a reliable vendor. Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one. It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents. Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.

Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Centralisation (Noun)
केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Sophistication (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Sophistication' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Organisational (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Organisational' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of cent' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of c' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of c' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear." (Hinglish Arth: इंटरनेट की संरचना को केंद्रीकृत करने के खतरे अब स्पष्ट हैं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even..." articles.title: Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While maintaining its hard stance on cross-border terrorism, India has an opportunity to recognise that many of its other interests still merit sustained cooperation with Pakistan as the latter’s climate minister Musadik Masood Malik prepares to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. India’s official position since the Pahalgam attack and the ensuing confrontations along the border is that terrorism and bilateral talks cannot coexist. A month later, Prime Minister Narendra Modi signalled that India’s relations with Pakistan would remain subordinate to its demands on cross-border terrorism by extending the condition to trade and water. South Asia is already one of the least economically integrated regions worldwide, with intra-regional trade at around 5%, and, as Chatham House has inferred, strained ties between India and its neighbours have created diplomatic vacuums that Beijing has taken advantage of through trilateral and regional groupings. Now, by inviting all SCO members to the national capital and participating in meetings ahead of the August 2027 Islamabad Summit, New Delhi has shown some maturity as a convening power. Islamabad is also being pragmatic in keeping channels open during its SCO chairmanship by participating in an initiative championed by Mr. Modi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The pursuit of regionwide water security remains particularly fluid, with India seemingly overlooking the fact that it is upstream of Pakistan and Bangladesh and downstream of China. After India stopped sharing routine hydrological data of the Indus river and approved the Chenab-Beas link tunnel project, Mr. Malik fanned the flames saying Pakistan would “cut off those hands” seeking to restrict its share of the water. Yet China has now restricted the same data vis-à-vis the Brahmaputra while it builds the Medog mega-dam in Tibet. India has also protested the proposed Padma Barrage in Bangladesh, which has been increasing its alignment with China, echoing India building the Farakka Barrage over East Pakistan’s objections in 1961. Climate change is rendering cooperation more essential to manage the integrity of contested geographies, the willingness of border populations to engage, and the potential to generate hydroelectric power. New Delhi should retreat from the notion that working together on the Indus will be a concession to Islamabad and see in the Dialogue an opportunity to restore the necessary channels. Suspending ties may communicate political resolve but will not diminish terrorists’ capabilities in the region or improve India’s security. It has already compromised India’s ambitions to regional leadership, which require the ability to keep engaging even with difficult neighbours. India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its interests, including with Pakistan.

Climate change is rendering cooperation more essential to manage the integrity of contested geographies, the willingness of border populations to engage, and the potential to generate hydroelectric power. New Delhi should retreat from the notion that working together on the Indus will be a concession to Islamabad and see in the Dialogue an opportunity to restore the necessary channels. Suspending ties may communicate political resolve but will not diminish terrorists’ capabilities in the region or improve India’s security. It has already compromised India’s ambitions to regional leadership, which require the ability to keep engaging even with difficult neighbours. India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its interests, including with Pakistan.

hinglishTracks.en: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत को द्विपक्षीय सहयोग को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए बहुपक्षीय मंचों का उपयोग करना चाहिए। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Multilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बहुपक्षीय — जिसमें दो से अधिक देश (जैसे UN, G20, BRICS) मिलकर साझा फैसला लेते हैं। इसके Synonyms हैं: Plurilateral, International, Coalition-based और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, One-sided, Isolated।

hinglishTracks.en: While maintaining its hard stance on cross-border terrorism, India has an opportunity to recognise that many of its other interests still merit sustained cooperation with Pakistan as the latter’s climate minister Musadik Masood Malik prepares to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सीमा पार आतंकवाद पर अपना सख्त रुख बरकरार रखते हुए, भारत के पास यह पहचानने का अवसर है कि उसके कई अन्य हित अभी भी पाकिस्तान के साथ निरंतर सहयोग के लायक हैं क्योंकि पाकिस्तान के जलवायु मंत्री मुसादिक मसूद मलिक नई दिल्ली में शंघाई सहयोग संगठन (एससीओ) सभ्यता संवाद मंच में भाग लेने की तैयारी कर रहे हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sustainability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास। इसके Synonyms हैं: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability और Antonyms हैं: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction।

hinglishTracks.en: India’s official position since the Pahalgam attack and the ensuing confrontations along the border is that terrorism and bilateral talks cannot coexist.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पहलगाम हमले और सीमा पर उसके बाद हुए टकराव के बाद से भारत की आधिकारिक स्थिति यह है कि आतंकवाद और द्विपक्षीय वार्ता एक साथ नहीं रह सकते।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: A month later, Prime Minister Narendra Modi signalled that India’s relations with Pakistan would remain subordinate to its demands on cross-border terrorism by extending the condition to trade and water.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक महीने बाद, प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने संकेत दिया कि व्यापार और पानी की शर्त को बढ़ाकर पाकिस्तान के साथ भारत के संबंध सीमा पार आतंकवाद पर उसकी मांगों के अधीन रहेंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: South Asia is already one of the least economically integrated regions worldwide, with intra-regional trade at around 5%, and, as Chatham House has inferred, strained ties between India and its neighbours have created diplomatic vacuums that Beijing has taken advantage of through trilateral and regional groupings.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — दक्षिण एशिया पहले से ही दुनिया भर में सबसे कम आर्थिक रूप से एकीकृत क्षेत्रों में से एक है, जिसमें अंतर-क्षेत्रीय व्यापार लगभग 5% है, और, जैसा कि चैथम हाउस ने अनुमान लगाया है, भारत और उसके पड़ोसियों के बीच तनावपूर्ण संबंधों ने राजनयिक शून्यता पैदा कर दी है जिसका बीजिंग ने त्रिपक्षीय और क्षेत्रीय समूहों के माध्यम से लाभ उठाया है।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:54:10 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While maintaining its hard stance on cross-border terrorism, India has an opportunity to recognise that many of its other interests still merit sustained cooperation with Pakistan as the latter’s climate minister Musadik Masood Malik prepares to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. India’s official position since the Pahalgam attack and the ensuing confrontations along the border is that terrorism and bilateral talks cannot coexist. A month later, Prime Minister Narendra Modi signalled that India’s relations with Pakistan would remain subordinate to its demands on cross-border terrorism by extending the condition to trade and water. South Asia is already one of the least economically integrated regions worldwide, with intra-regional trade at around 5%, and, as Chatham House has inferred, strained ties between India and its neighbours have created diplomatic vacuums that Beijing has taken advantage of through trilateral and regional groupings. Now, by inviting all SCO members to the national capital and participating in meetings ahead of the August 2027 Islamabad Summit, New Delhi has shown some maturity as a convening power. Islamabad is also being pragmatic in keeping channels open during its SCO chairmanship by participating in an initiative championed by Mr. Modi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The pursuit of regionwide water security remains particularly fluid, with India seemingly overlooking the fact that it is upstream of Pakistan and Bangladesh and downstream of China. After India stopped sharing routine hydrological data of the Indus river and approved the Chenab-Beas link tunnel project, Mr. Malik fanned the flames saying Pakistan would “cut off those hands” seeking to restrict its share of the water. Yet China has now restricted the same data vis-à-vis the Brahmaputra while it builds the Medog mega-dam in Tibet. India has also protested the proposed Padma Barrage in Bangladesh, which has been increasing its alignment with China, echoing India building the Farakka Barrage over East Pakistan’s objections in 1961. articles.title: Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Islam is projected to be the world's largest religion by 2035, surpassing Christianity, according to a new study released by the Pew Research Centre on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). Pew said if current trends continue, there will be more than 3.6 billion Muslims and just under three billion Christians worldwide by 2070. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070. But the rest of the world's population -- all non-Hindus -- will grow at an even faster rate. As a result, Hindus will shrink slightly as a share of the global population, falling from 15% in 2020 to 14% in 2070. The world's total population is projected to increase by 29% between 2020 and 2070, with Christians growing by 30% and Muslims by 80%. "The largest source of new members of major religions is not adults who convert to the faith, but babies who are born into the group," the Pew projections found. During 2020-2025, the fertility rate for Muslims was 3.1 children per woman, followed by the rate for Christians at 2.5, Pew said. The average fertility rate for all other women was 1.6, below the 2.1 level considered necessary for each generation to replace itself. If current demographic trends continue, the number of Hindus in India will increase by 176 million between 2020 and 2070. While India's overall fertility rate has fallen rapidly in recent decades, Muslims in India still have more children per woman than Hindus do, the Pew Research found. As per the Pew projections, Hindus comprise 79.4% of India's religious composition in 2020 and the number is set to slide to 75.8% by 2070. Muslims comprise 15.2% of India's religious composition in 2020, and that share is set to rise to 19.6% by 2070. Outside India, much of the projected growth among Hindus will come from Pakistan (over five million) and the United States (over four million).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the Pew projections, the U.S. will have the world's fifth-largest Hindu population. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (19 NOV)

📰 Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research

📌 Published: 19 Nov 2026, 06:57:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Islam is projected to be the world's largest religion by 2035, surpassing Christianity, according to a new study released by the Pew Research Centre on Wednesday (November 18, 2026). Pew said if current trends continue, there will be more than 3.6 billion Muslims and just under three billion Christians worldwide by 2070. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070. But the rest of the world's population -- all non-Hindus -- will grow at an even faster rate. As a result, Hindus will shrink slightly as a share of the global population, falling from 15% in 2020 to 14% in 2070. The world's total population is projected to increase by 29% between 2020 and 2070, with Christians growing by 30% and Muslims by 80%. "The largest source of new members of major religions is not adults who convert to the faith, but babies who are born into the group," the Pew projections found. During 2020-2025, the fertility rate for Muslims was 3.1 children per woman, followed by the rate for Christians at 2.5, Pew said. The average fertility rate for all other women was 1.6, below the 2.1 level considered necessary for each generation to replace itself. If current demographic trends continue, the number of Hindus in India will increase by 176 million between 2020 and 2070. While India's overall fertility rate has fallen rapidly in recent decades, Muslims in India still have more children per woman than Hindus do, the Pew Research found. As per the Pew projections, Hindus comprise 79.4% of India's religious composition in 2020 and the number is set to slide to 75.8% by 2070. Muslims comprise 15.2% of India's religious composition in 2020, and that share is set to rise to 19.6% by 2070. Outside India, much of the projected growth among Hindus will come from Pakistan (over five million) and the United States (over four million).

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to the Pew projections, the U.S. will have the world's fifth-largest Hindu population. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwid' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 world' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 world' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The absolute number of Hindus in India and worldwide will rise from 1.2 billion in 2020 to 1.4 billion by 2070." (Hinglish Arth: भारत और दुनिया भर में हिंदुओं की कुल संख्या 2020 में 1.2 बिलियन से बढ़कर 2070 तक 1.4 बिलियन हो जाएगी)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Muslims to outnumber Christians by 2035 worldwide: Pew research"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Nepal and India will remain the only two countries with a Hindu majority." (Hinglish Arth: नेपाल और भारत ही हिंदू बहुमत वाले दो देश रह जाएंगे।)

articles.title: Kochi Corporation spends over ₹4 crore a year on nearly 2,000 defunct public taps
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nearly 2,000 of the 5,358 public taps identified in the city remain dysfunctional, for which the Kochi Corporation continues to pay the Kerala Water Authority (KWA) over ₹4 crore annually, resulting in a drain on the resources of the cash-strapped civic body. A recent survey conducted by the Corporation through its overseers, in consultation with division councillors, found that 3,303 public taps were functional, while 1,995 were non-functional across the city. Each public tap costs the Corporation ₹21,838 a year, irrespective of whether it is functional, taking the total annual expenditure to ₹11.70 crore. According to a letter issued by the KWA on November 6, 2025, there were 5,444 public taps within the city limits. The latest survey shows a marginal decline of 86 taps. Until the previous government completely wrote off the water charge arrears, around ₹5 crore used to be deducted annually from the Corporation’s Plan fund towards the dues. Mayor V.K. Minimol said that despite free water connections provided under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation, several divisions still had more than 50 and even 100 public taps. The 18 divisions in West Kochi alone accounted for 2,216 taps, of which 1,623 were non-functional, translating into an annual expenditure of over ₹3.54 crore. Earavely division has the highest number of taps (263), followed by Mattancherry (215), Kalvathy (189), and Karippalam (174). “Councillors should take a serious look at this list and scrutinise it further so that only those taps that are absolutely necessary are retained and the rest surrendered to the KWA. To check misuse of public taps, they will be remodelled with concrete structures, as was done in the past, and fitted with meters,” Ms. Minimol said. LDF parliamentary party leader V.A. Sreejith said that while taps that are no longer in use could be surrendered, councillors should not be made responsible for issuing letters to the KWA seeking their removal. This, he said, would spare councillors from having to bear the brunt of public resentment over such a move.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: BJP councillor Priya Prasanth said it was imperative to ensure the availability of drinking water in an area before scrapping an existing public tap. Despite having water connections, there could still be households without a reliable water supply and, therefore, dependent on public taps. Such taps should be retained, she added.
